title: Fix Compose Desktop White Screen
description: Desktop Electron shows white screen; align sketchpad package entry with index.tsx.
summary: Fixed @semio-tech/compose-sketchpad package exports pointing at missing index.ts (actual entry is index.tsx), which broke Vite resolution for the desktop renderer lazy import and caused a blank window. Updated desktop vite optimizeDeps entry to index.tsx. Verified: npx vite build --config compose/desktop/vite.renderer.config.ts (exit 0).
